competitions.name: Consularium - The McKinsey Consulting Event
competitions.description: The marquee management consulting event hosted in collaboration with McKinsey & Company at DoMS IIT Madras. Student teams formulate high-stakes business transformation and strategy solutions evaluated directly by McKinsey consultants.
competitions.eligibility: All MBA and business postgraduate students. Cross-institute teams allowed.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,00,000 Total Prize Pool + Fast-track Interview Opportunities and direct review by McKinsey consultants.
competitions.additional_resources: Harvard Business School case frameworks, structured hypothesis matrices.

competitions.name: Circus Maximus - Marketing Flagship Event - 2026
competitions.description: The premier national marketing case competition organized by XLRI Jamshedpur as part of Ensemble Valhalla 2026. Formulate disruptive brand revitalization campaigns, omnichannel consumer engagement strategies, and performance marketing playbooks.
competitions.eligibility: Open to first and second-year MBA students from recognized B-Schools.
competitions.prize_details: ₹2,00,000 Cash Prize + Certificate of Excellence from XLRI Jamshedpur.
competitions.additional_resources: Retail audit data, brand perception studies.

competitions.name: Genesis - Flagship Finance Event- 2026
competitions.description: Flagship corporate finance and valuation challenge at XLRI Jamshedpur. Analyze cross-border M&A transactions, capital structure optimization, and private equity buyout modeling.
competitions.eligibility: Enrolled MBA and business postgraduate students specializing in Finance.
competitions.prize_details: ₹2,00,000 Total Prize Pool + Advisory interaction with finance leaders.

competitions.name: Fetch-A-Thon 3.0 — Business Hackathon
competitions.description: An intense 48-hour business and product hackathon at Masters’ Union. MBA students and tech product builders collaborate to solve real customer problems and present scalable startup prototypes.
competitions.eligibility: Open to MBA students, undergraduate innovators, and startup enthusiasts.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,50,000 Cash Pool + Pitch session to venture capital partners.

competitions.name: AI Product Hackathon
competitions.description: A nationwide product and AI hackathon testing business acumen, market sizing, UI/UX architecture, and agentic workflows. Design intelligent software features that solve high-friction enterprise workflows.
competitions.eligibility: Open to management students, product managers, and builders.
competitions.prize_details: ₹2,00,000 Prize Pool + Fast-track interview referrals for APM and Product Strategy roles.

competitions.name: Strategikon - Consulting Flagship Event 2026
competitions.description: The flagship management consulting case competition organized by XLRI Jamshedpur as part of Ensemble Valhalla 2026. Teams tackle high-impact corporate turnaround, market entry, and digital transformation strategy.
competitions.eligibility: All MBA and post-graduate business management students nationwide.
competitions.prize_details: ₹2,50,000 Prize Pool + Live Presentation at XLRI Jamshedpur campus.

competitions.name: TrenDSetter 5.0- Marketing Track
competitions.description: A marquee corporate live case competition hosted by Dharampal Satyapal Group (DS Group). MBA students solve live market challenges across confectionary, spices, and luxury lifestyle verticals, with direct pre-placement interview (PPI) opportunities.
competitions.eligibility: 1st & 2nd Year MBA/PGDM students from accredited B-Schools.
competitions.prize_details: ₹5,00,000 Winner Pool + Pre-Placement Interviews (PPI) across DS Group business units.

competitions.name: Sankalp: Season 5 - A Consulting Case Competition
competitions.description: XLRI Delhi’s marquee consulting case challenge hosted during Nova Exilaro 2026. Student consultants dissect live business problems, propose structured strategic frameworks, and pitch directly to consulting partners.
competitions.eligibility: Full-time MBA/PGDM candidates from recognized management institutes.

competitions.name: Caseception (Case Competition)
competitions.organizer: Symbiosis Center for Information Technology (SCIT), Pune
competitions.description: Flagship business case competition at SCIT Pune testing critical thinking, crisis response, and stakeholder alignment under tight analytical constraints.
competitions.eligibility: Open to enrolled college and MBA / Postgraduate management students.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,20,000 Prize Pool + Certificates of Merit from Symbiosis.

competitions.name: Chanakyaniti: The National Strategy Challenge
competitions.organizer: Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies (NMIMS), Bangalore
competitions.description: National-level business strategy challenge hosted by NMIMS Bangalore. Step into the C-suite to formulate robust turnaround roadmaps, market expansion models, and digital transformation blueprints.
competitions.eligibility: All MBA and post-graduate business students across India.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,50,000 Total Prize Pool + Certificates from NMIMS Bangalore.

competitions.name: The Good, The Bad, and The Business: Marketing Track
competitions.description: Premier marketing case simulation at IMT Ghaziabad challenging management minds to revitalize consumer goods, craft brand narrative pivots, and optimize digital funnels.
competitions.eligibility: Full-time MBA/PGDM students from accredited Indian management institutes.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,00,000 Cash Award + National recognition at IMT Ghaziabad.

competitions.name: Consulting: Strategy Under Pressure
competitions.description: High-velocity consulting case tournament under strict time limits. Formulate hypothesis trees, build defensible financial models, and pitch recommendations to senior consulting leaders.
competitions.eligibility: Open to all enrolled MBA and postgraduate business management students.
competitions.prize_details: ₹1,50,000 Prize Pool + Mentorship from top-tier management consultants.

team_listings.headline: Consulting veterans seeking 1 financial modeler & slide designer
team_listings.description: We are two Year-2 MBA students with consulting internship experience at Big 4. Need someone skilled in 3-statement financial modeling and storyboarding clean executive decks.
team_listings.contact_method: Reach out via Case Hub chat or meet at Campus Library Pod B.

team_listings.headline: Creative FMCG enthusiasts looking for 1 consumer insights specialist
team_listings.description: Aiming for national finals! We have strong branding & go-to-market experience, need a partner who loves consumer interviews and digital growth loops.
